page_list.portal_help_point_optional: A portal is optional. The list of pages underneath is shown whether or not a portal exists.

admin.plugins.heading: Plugins
admin.plugins.lead: Configure each installed plugin's options. Default-on plugins (e.g. local file storage) appear here even when not explicitly listed in crowi.config.json.
admin.plugins.empty_body: Add plugin packages to crowi.config.json:plugins to surface them here.
admin.plugins.save_succeeded_reconfigure: Saved, but apply failed — see server logs
admin.plugins.edit_description: Edit this plugin's configuration. Sensitive fields are encrypted at rest.
admin.plugins.clear_cache_confirm_body_a: Every cached embed will be re-rendered on the next page view. Costly upstream calls may follow. Proceed?
admin.plugins.clear_cache_confirm_body_p: Every cached entry contributed by '{name}' will be removed. The next page view re-runs render() for that plugin. Proceed?
admin.crypto.key_missing_lead: Without CROWI_ENCRYPTION_KEY, OAuth secrets and SMTP passwords are stored in plaintext.
admin.crypto.key_missing_restart: Restart the server after setting it.
admin.crypto.unencrypted_body: Sensitive data was saved before the encryption key was set. Click the button below to re-encrypt all entries with the current key (the values are not changed).
admin.crypto.empty_body: OAuth secrets and SMTP passwords will be encrypted automatically when saved.
admin.security.heading: Security settings
admin.security.basic_auth_tip1: Basic auth applies a single username/password gate to the entire wiki.
admin.security.basic_auth_tip2: Note that the credentials are sent unencrypted in the request.
admin.security.whitelist_help1: Restrict which email addresses can register. One address per line.
admin.security.section_registration_lead: Control how new users can sign up.
admin.security.mode_restricted_descripti: Only addresses in the whitelist can register.
admin.security.field_whitelist_help: One entry per line — domain or full address that may register. Used only when the mode is Restricted.
admin.security.section_basic_lead: Apply a single Basic-auth gate to the whole site. Leave both fields empty to disable.
admin.security.field_basic_secret_help: Stored / shown in plain text, mirroring the legacy admin behaviour.
admin.auth.heading: Authentication settings
admin.auth.lead: Toggle whether third-party authentication is mandatory and whether password login is disabled. Saving is guarded server-side to prevent the acting admin from locking themselves out.
admin.auth.section_password_lead: Control which authentication methods are available to users.
admin.auth.field_require_thirdparty_auth: When enabled, users without a connected Google or GitHub identity are blocked from accessing content after login.
admin.auth.field_disable_password_auth_h: When enabled, email + password login is turned off. Only third-party providers (Google / GitHub) remain available.
admin.auth.warning_disable_password_requ: Disabling password authentication requires the acting admin to already be connected to a valid third-party identity (Google / GitHub). The save will be blocked server-side if the connection is missing.
admin.app.heading: Application settings
admin.app.lead: Site title and confidential-information notice. Storage credentials (S3 etc.) are managed under /admin/plugins?name=@crowi/plugin-aws.
admin.app.field_confidential_placeholder: Notice about content that must not be posted on this wiki (rendered at the top).
admin.storage.heading: Storage
admin.storage.lead: Read-only view of the active storage driver and the drivers any loaded plugin has registered.
admin.storage.active_none: No storage driver is active. Check crowi.config.json:storage.driver.
admin.storage.installed_lead: Every storage driver registered by a loaded plugin. Click a row to open the plugin's settings page.
admin.storage.hint_switch: Switching: edit crowi.config.json:storage.driver and restart the process.
admin.search.heading: Search index
admin.search.lead: Read-only view of the active search driver and the drivers any loaded plugin has registered.
admin.search.active_none: No search driver is active. Check crowi.config.json:search.driver.
admin.search.installed_lead: Every search driver registered by a loaded plugin. Click a row to open the plugin's settings page.
admin.search.hint_switch: Switching: edit crowi.config.json:search.driver and restart the process.
admin.common.field_secret_placeholder_se: Leave empty to keep the current value
admin.mail.heading: Mail settings
admin.mail.lead: SMTP / AWS SES configuration used for notification mails and test sends. The SMTP password and SES secret access key are encrypted at rest.
admin.mail.section_from_lead: From address used by all Crowi-sent mail. Mail is disabled when this is blank.
admin.mail.section_smtp_lead: Direct SMTP delivery. SMTP wins over SES when both host and port are set.
admin.mail.section_ses_lead: AWS SES delivery. Used only when SMTP host is empty and both SES access key and secret access key are set.
admin.mail.section_test_lead: Send a test mail using the current form values via SMTP.
admin.mail.section_test_lead_with_email: Send a test mail using the current form values via SMTP. Recipient: {email}
admin.users.heading: Users
admin.users.lead: Browse, search, and review every user account on this wiki.
admin.users.search_placeholder: Search by username, name, or email
admin.users.empty_body: No user matches the current search.
admin.users.action.self_disabled_hint: You cannot perform this action on your own account.
admin.users.action.invite_dialog_descrip: Enter one email per line. Existing accounts are skipped automatically.
admin.users.action.invite_invalid_emails: Some entries are not valid email addresses: {emails}
admin.users.action.invite_no_emails: Enter at least one email address.
admin.users.action.edit_dialog_descripti: Update the user's display name and email address.
admin.users.action.email_conflict: This email is already used by another user.
admin.users.action.reset_password_dialog: A new random password will be generated for {name} and shown only once. The user's current password will stop working immediately.
admin.users.action.reset_password_result: This password will not be shown again. Copy it and share it with the user through a secure channel.
admin.users.action.update_email_dialog_d: Update only the user's email address.
admin.users.action.confirm_make_admin_de: {name} will gain access to every admin page and all destructive operations.
admin.users.action.confirm_remove_admin_: {name} will lose access to all admin pages immediately.
admin.users.action.confirm_activate_desc: {name} will be able to sign in again.
admin.users.action.confirm_suspend_descr: {name} will be signed out and prevented from signing in until reactivated.
admin.share.heading: Share settings
admin.share.lead: Control whether pages can be shared externally via share links.
admin.share.section_external_lead: When enabled, page authors can publish a public read-only URL for any page. Disabling this immediately blocks all existing share links and the share CRUD endpoints.
admin.share.field_external_help: Off by default. Re-enable to expose share links and the per-page share dialog.
